method: Full navigations with browser cache enabled; requested visible tab but preview reported visible=false. Representative home heading was already present and Performance paint entries empty. No passive pre-load readiness timestamp captured; no estimates used. Resource count and transferSize are browser Performance entries after the first desktop load, excluding unobservable cross-origin transfer sizes and subject to caching. Console and failed-request counts unavailable per navigation. Phone uses iPhone 12 Pro preset, innerWidth verified 390; document scrollWidth only, no visual inspection. Desktop innerWidth 1280.

missing_value_reasons.transferred_kb: Cross-origin and cached transfer sizes have visibility limits; gate bytes omitted.
